cv.grouping_key: run_id + pair_id (one effective group per pair)

probes.detail: future observations after 60 s mutated; 61 past anchors unchanged
an unpartitioned run is refused before any feature window is built
4 grouped folds are disjoint and cover every development run once
every paired S1/S2 arm stays inside one fold side
locked-test runs are refused by the run builder and the fold validator
a Controller B interventional trajectory is refused for observational training
two export views of one physical source are refused as independent groups
a contradictory duplicate delivery fails closed in episode construction
a mixed-boot trajectory is refused before feature computation
a transform fitted on validation groups identifies and refuses the illegal population
a future critical-event field cannot enter the feature allowlist
a missing/UNKNOWN electrical value becomes NaN, never a silent zero
mixed hardware/config lineages are refused as non-comparable
AP and every predeclared strategy/fold are reported; no best-fold selection
a forged GREEN manifest without a matching W08 receipt is refused

records.attack_mechanism: Rows or windows from one run land in both train and validation.
records.preventive_check: The split API accepts runs and effective groups, never rows; train and validation groups must be disjoint.
records.residual_limitation: The audit cannot prove a future caller will not build a row-level dataset outside this API.
records.scientific_consequence: A row split would overstate AP by memorising one run's thermal history.
records.title: Random row split

records.attack_mechanism: Overlapping windows are generated before run partition and leak across folds.
records.preventive_check: Features and labels are built only for runs whose split partition is development; an unpartitioned run is refused.
records.residual_limitation: The benchmark trusts the supplied split identity; a forged split is outside this software control.
records.scientific_consequence: Window-before-split can make empty folds look separable.
records.title: Window before split

records.attack_mechanism: A rolling statistic uses samples after the anchor.
records.preventive_check: Future mutation/truncation probes must leave every past feature byte-identical.
records.residual_limitation: Covers the registered feature set only.
records.scientific_consequence: Future leakage would make the model clairvoyant at prediction time.
records.title: Future rolling feature

records.attack_mechanism: A command, door or electrical state after t enters X_t.
records.preventive_check: The same future mutation probe mutates all post-anchor command/state fields.
records.residual_limitation: Feature definitions are frozen only by the W10 registry identity.
records.scientific_consequence: A post-intervention state in X cannot be known by Controller A.
records.title: Future command/state

records.attack_mechanism: An imputer or scaler is fitted on the union of training and validation groups.
records.preventive_check: The API refuses any fit population that includes a non-training group; XGBoost's native NaN handling makes a global imputer unnecessary.
records.residual_limitation: A caller could implement a transform outside this API.
records.scientific_consequence: Validation statistics would leak the validation distribution into training.
records.title: Global imputation/scaling

records.attack_mechanism: A calibrator is fitted on the locked test partition.
records.preventive_check: No calibration is performed; outputs are labelled risk_score and calibration_status is NOT_PERFORMED.
records.residual_limitation: If calibration is added later, it must be fitted on grouped development data only.
records.scientific_consequence: Uncalibrated scores must not be called physical probabilities.
records.title: Test-set calibration

records.attack_mechanism: A decision threshold is tuned using locked-test outcomes.
records.preventive_check: The operating threshold is predeclared in the config; locked-test runs are refused before prediction.
records.residual_limitation: The numeric 0.5 is an illustrative development operating point, not a tuned test result.
records.title: Test-set threshold selection

records.attack_mechanism: A renamed export or second view of one boot is counted as another run.
records.preventive_check: Each source hash and physical_source_key may belong to exactly one run and one effective group.
records.residual_limitation: Source identity is only as strong as the W04/W08 provenance.
records.scientific_consequence: Duplicate exports inflate the apparent independent population.
records.title: Near-duplicate groups

records.attack_mechanism: A Controller B interventional trajectory is used as an observational negative.
records.preventive_check: Predictive controller ids are refused for observational training.
records.residual_limitation: Controller id strings are a declared contract, not a hardware attestation.
records.scientific_consequence: An event prevented by intervention is an unobserved counterfactual, not a negative.
records.title: Predictive intervention contamination

records.attack_mechanism: Critical-event time, y or a post-intervention outcome is inserted into X.
records.preventive_check: The explicit allowlist must contain only frozen registry features; provenance/target fields are rejected.
records.residual_limitation: A caller could bypass the config loader and construct a custom matrix.
records.scientific_consequence: Label leakage yields a near-perfect but meaningless AP.
records.title: Future label into feature

records.attack_mechanism: P3 outcomes are inspected during W11 development.
records.preventive_check: Locked-test runs are refused by both the run builder and fold validator; the W10 test pair is untouched.
records.residual_limitation: No real P3 population exists yet; W12 owns the locked-test boundary.
records.scientific_consequence: Any test peek invalidates the later Gate G3 report.
records.title: Locked test peeking

records.attack_mechanism: A repeated sample delivery is treated as a new independent observation.
records.preventive_check: Contradictory duplicate identities fail closed; identical duplicates are deduplicated.
records.residual_limitation: Adapter-level dedup depends on the quality of sample identity.
records.scientific_consequence: Repeated deliveries can inflate sample counts and apparent warning episodes.
records.title: Duplicate delivery

records.attack_mechanism: Samples from separate boots are stitched onto one time axis.
records.preventive_check: A trajectory is one device/boot acquisition domain; mixed boots are refused and must be partitioned by an adapter.
records.residual_limitation: Boot-scoped uptime is not absolute UTC; W11 real admission requires EVENT_UTC.
records.scientific_consequence: Cross-boot continuity fabricates thermal history that never existed.
records.title: Boot/time semantics

records.attack_mechanism: UNKNOWN electrical quality is silently filled with 0 W or 0 A.
records.preventive_check: None/absent values become NaN; the matrix never substitutes zero.
records.residual_limitation: The model treats NaN natively; missingness semantics remain an assumption of the fixture.
records.scientific_consequence: Zero-filling would fabricate a measured no-load state.
records.title: Missing electrical equals zero

records.attack_mechanism: Runs from different hardware or configuration lineages are pooled.
records.preventive_check: More than one hardware/config lineage in development is refused.
records.residual_limitation: The single-rig fixture has no real multi-lineage evidence.
records.scientific_consequence: Pooled hardware can confound thermal behaviour with model skill.
records.title: Hardware/config identity

records.attack_mechanism: A model learns ambient or day-specific context that is not stable for deployment.
records.preventive_check: No multi-day, A-valid physical population exists to probe drift.
records.residual_limitation: Needs a qualified multi-day physical dataset; synthetic fixtures cannot establish drift.
records.scientific_consequence: Deployment performance may degrade when ambient conditions change.
records.title: Ambient/day covariate drift

records.attack_mechanism: The best-looking fold or metric is selected after seeing outcomes.
records.preventive_check: AP and all predeclared folds/strategies are reported; no post-hoc best-fold selection.
records.residual_limitation: A human could still selectively quote a favorable fold; the report keeps every fold visible.
records.title: Metric/definition shopping

verification.training_only_preprocessing: XGBoost native NaN handling; no global fit
